summary: @servicetitan/anvil-react preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes 727KB obfuscated sibling payload
details: The package's preinstall lifecycle script (setup.mjs) downloads the Bun JavaScript runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases into a temporary directory, chmods it executable, and uses it to execFileSync a bundled sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is a ~727KB `// @bun @bun-cjs`-marked blob using the obfuscator.io string-array/rotation + custom-alphabet decoder pattern (array rotator WV8StW, decoder hc1jfK9), with no readable functionality and no relation to a React component library. setup.mjs itself is obfuscated (mangled _0x-style identifiers, string-map indirection). Running the payload under a freshly-downloaded alternate runtime causes it to execute outside Node.js, bypassing Node-level instrumentation and scanners. The full behavior of math_init.js is therefore executed at `npm install` time on the installer's machine as opaque, obfuscator-encoded code fetched into the install environment via a non-Node execution path.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
